thread:
Logan (Acct Mgmt): Aurelia Labs reported a surprise overage on their March dedicated commit invoice (INV-20260307-AUR). They say ~14% higher than expected, asking for line-item breakdown and any SLA credit applied. Can we confirm?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-20260307-AUR created for acct-AUR-998 (total $31,320).

Asha (Finance): Thanks — can you paste the account id and which commit tier they have? I’ll pull the metering-export.

Logan (Acct Mgmt): acct-AUR-998, reserved commit = 1x p4d-equivalent pool (monthly). Customer says commit should cover 1,200 GPU-hours, but invoice shows 1,430 billed GPU-hours.

devon (Billing Eng): I pulled the metering. There's a short window 2026-03-02T00:50:00Z -> 2026-03-02T04:10:00Z where we saw duplicate burst counts during an autoscaler failover in eu-west-1. Looks like a double-emission for ~45 GPU-hours.

Asha (Finance): OK can you do a quick calc of reserved vs burst and propose credit amount?

devon (Billing Eng): Yep — raw numbers from the ETL: 
```
Reserved commit cap: 1,200 GPU-hours (monthly)
Metered reserved usage: 1,200 GPU-hours
Raw burst recorded: 230 GPU-hours
Identified duplicate inflation: 45 GPU-hours
Net burst after dedupe: 185 GPU-hours
Unit price (burst): $15.00 / GPU-hour
Gross burst charge: $3,450.00
Credit for duplicated meters: -$675.00
SLA credit (pro-rated): $4,500.00  # per SLO calc for sustained latency loss
Net overage / refund due: -$1,725.00  # negative => refund to customer
```

Asha (Finance): Good detail. So invoice shows $3,450 burst + reserved lines, but with duplication correction and SLA credit we owe them $1,725. I'll generate a pro-forma credit note and request accounting to issue a refund/offset.

trevor (Sales): Please keep Aurelia in the loop. They asked for ETA on resolution — can we commit to timeline? :eyes:

Asha (Finance): I will prepare credit note by EOD today and send adjusted invoice tomorrow morning (PST). Accounting will process refund/offset within 5 business days after acceptance.

Logan (Acct Mgmt): I'll message the customer with the breakdown and the pro-forma when you post it. cc @trevor.

devon (Billing Eng): Root cause: autoscaler double-ack during node swap. Fix patch queued and will go out with next billing pipeline deploy (tomorrow). I'll add a one-off reconciler to catch similar dupes for March. :white_check_mark:

Asha (Finance): Thanks — assigning ticket FIN-4671 to track credit issuance and invoice reissue.

Logan (Acct Mgmt): Perfect, thanks everyone. I’ll ping once customer confirms. :thumbsup:
